subtopics.title: Summit Overview and Theme
subtopics.summary: India hosted the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi in 2026, marking its 4th BRICS Chairship. The summit ran under the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'. It ended with the unanimous adoption of the New Delhi Declaration, which stressed multilateralism and Global South representation. The year also marked 25 years since the BRIC concept emerged in 2001.
facts: 18th BRICS Summit held in New Delhi in 2026
2026 was India's 4th BRICS Chairship
Earlier Indian chairships: 2012 (4th summit, New Delhi), 2016 (8th, Goa), 2021 (13th, virtual)
Theme 2026: Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability
New Delhi Declaration adopted unanimously at the close of the summit
Declaration stressed multilateralism, conflict prevention, equitable global governance and Global South representation
2026 marked 25 years since the BRIC concept emerged in 2001
Resilience: strengthening ability to deal with economic, environmental and geopolitical challenges
Innovation: promoting new technologies, research and digital solutions for development
Cooperation and Sustainability: collaboration across sectors and environmentally sustainable, inclusive growth

subtopics.title: Science, Technology and Digital Infrastructure
subtopics.summary: The science and digital outcomes cover space, satellite data, digital public infrastructure, research infrastructure, smart grids and entrepreneurship. Terms were drafted for a proposed space council, and a repository for digital public infrastructure was approved. An action plan was adopted for a network that pools resources for high-cost megascience projects. An incubator network was launched to support innovation-led growth.
facts: Terms drafted for a proposed BRICS Space Council
Cooperation under the BRICS Remote Sensing Satellite Constellation was expanded
Collective satellite data to support disaster risk reduction and climate monitoring
BRICS DPI Repository approved for creation
Pilot projects started for sharing open-source digital public goods, including digital identity and payment systems
GRAIN (Global Research Advanced Infrastructure Network): action plan adopted
GRAIN aims to pool financial and intellectual resources for high-cost megascience projects
Digital Centre of Excellence for Smart Grids established for AI-enabled integration of renewable energy
BRICS Incubator Network launched to promote entrepreneurship and innovation-led growth

subtopics.title: Security, Social Cooperation and Global Governance
subtopics.summary: Security outcomes include a condemnation of cross-border terrorism and an expert network for tracing fugitive offenders. BRICS CONNECT addresses capacity building and the rights of gig workers. On global governance, the summit endorsed greater African representation in the UN Security Council, and India proposed a 3R framework. China was confirmed as host of the 19th BRICS Summit in 2027.
facts: BRICS condemned cross-border terrorism and the 2025 Pahalgam terror attack
BRICS urged progress towards the UN Comprehensive Convention on International Terrorism
Expert network and repository established for tracing fugitive offenders
BRICS CONNECT: capacity building, employability and new skills
BRICS CONNECT aims to strengthen gig workers' rights and cross-border portability of social security
BRICS endorsed the Ezulwini Consensus and Sirte Declaration on African representation in the UN Security Council
India's 3R framework: Representation, Responsiveness, Rule-making
India's 10-point roadmap for global governance reform
BRICS endorsed WTO accession bids of Ethiopia and Iran
China confirmed as host of the 19th BRICS Summit in 2027
